rows.ARS:
Orange blend Floribunda.
Registration name: MEIgavesol
Exhibition name: Tequila ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, before 1978).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1980 as 'Tequila'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1981 as 'Tequila'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-red, red edges. Mild fragrance. 18 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, semi-double to double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 35" to 39" (90 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
